book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu qandi lek
Ka bouk wei Sabat eno la veil, me di wong en embei boyaing lek bouk ti myaxeeng wei sounda qes tiyon o, Maria wei Makdala is Maria nge la en embei na gyei leiveeng meyeing.
Woyom lutika eno tembuing pi ngandoung, en nambei Anutu xe angela lep me lam anghei tyoung gheyapu nei, me la ingwei leiveeng meyeing nei, me wilexe qakous la nale nenya dom dei lek.
E ma yon siing ambei zivip, me e xe teimb on teltyip ambei laxap.
Xel belimbo yon yaleeng en e, me etek niseikeing de pewilexe la yeip lek tembuing ambei xel meyeing.
Ekom angela neil wou vex yuw on, “Muw seng gwaleeng, en a woulek bei muw ghe di wimexe Yesu, wei xel tuw lek xax pepeeng o.
Moxo se toundei inye, en moxo qandi lek, nambei kawei neil o. Muw lam wei nimbeeng kawei yeip lek o.

Muw ghe na daing me ghe na neil wou e xe xel betiyeing, ‘Tambiy moxo qandi lek veil meyeing me la tax en xam me la Galili. Tyek xam ghe na gwei e nanghei inyei.’ Wei, a lam en ambei nam a neil wou xam.”
Om xel vex on tup me la nanghei ingwei leiveeng nei. Luw yaleeng ekom luw wo xeindlala mouyo, me veimyend bei na neil wou e xe xel betiyeing.
Se denlek en Yesu la tyip wou luw. Moxo neil, “Satiboukeing.” Luw lam wou me axlek e vaxa dom wo lalo wou e.
Woyom Yesu neil wou luw, “Muw seng gwaleeng. Muw la neil wou a lingyeiw bei xel na Galili, de tyek xel gyei ay anghei inyei.”
Qayeeng wei xel belimbo yo
Ka vex yuw on di la wou sakwaing, xel belimbo yon valu la eivek beyeeng ngandoung me la neil qayeeng on wou xel lumuki leitata en lul dalus wei belup on.
Xel lumuki leitata is xel teivateiv qekuma me neil qayeeng ti. Xel wong malew ngandoung wou xel vevekyeiw,
me neil wou xel, “Xam a neil ambei nye bei, ‘Gyeik ingwei xa xeip eno moxo xe xel betiyeing lam eivek boukeing me panax e neing de qou me la.’
Wangwei qayeeng tine na wou lei ngandoung wei seyap o, tyek xa menyex wou qayeeng is e, en kandek xam seng na eivek nimaying.”
Om xel vevekyeiw qou malew on me wong ambei kawei neil wou xel o. De pavulek tine eno xel Yudayeiw mi neil e lala eivek ama senghoing me e lam tyip bouk ti gweimbeeng ne.
Yesu wong xuk ngandoung wou xel betiyeing
Woyom xel betiyeing xoumeeng ti la Galili, me la lukendu tiwei Yesu neil wou xel bei xel na yo.
Gyeik xel yei e, eno xel wong lalo wou e, ekom xel valu laleind wo yuw.
Woyom Yesu lam wou xel me neil, “Lei wei ngandoung dalus eivek tyoung gheyapu me lek tembuing eno Anutu wong wou ay.
Nambei nyon xam ghe na bong xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa ne bong ambei a xe betiyeing, me ghe zipek xel eivek Mang lei me Neu lei me Laweeng Vambuing lei,
me teyoxe xel bei xel bongis lul tambak tiwei a mi peti wou xam o. Wei, inye neing ayang, a mindei is xam teyei lek bouk sapa ne, me tyek a mi mendei is xam me ena tyip wou bouk wei la tip lek o.”
